newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Itogon-Suyoc mining ops remain suspended.
newsitem.headline: Itogon-Suyoc mining ops remain suspended.

text.p: Philippine gold and silver miner Itogon-Suyoc Mines Inc (ISMI) said on Thursday that mining operations will remain suspensed due to financial losses and a strike.
The company said that since the strike was declared on October 31, union members have barricaded the roads to the mine, mill and offices.
Despite a temporary restraining order obtained by the company in December, union members continue with their barricades, it said.
"With the present outcome of events, and financial problems, ISMI has no recourse but to still extend the suspension of operations," the company said in a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Last September, the company said its board decided to suspend mining operations for three to six months starting October 16.
It said it was halting operations temporarily to reduce losses while awaiting an environmental clearance certificate for additional exploration plans.
